title: Astrologaster
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#479, 2026-10-14), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.15, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26, D3DMetal, recipes steam, controller-sdl, corefonts, dotnet48, vcrun2022, bloody-spell and xact, rated 2 of 5: stuck on Loading for 29 minutes after starting or continuing a game. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Steam has a Mac version too, which the reporter found broken (they are working with the developer). The Windows version through Highball starts but hangs on Loading after New Game or Continue, which matches a hang Windows players describe in the game's Steam discussions, so it may not be Highball's. The developer reproduced the hang and ties it to macOS 27 (highball-db#479, 2026-10-14). Since then the developer has fixed the Mac version, which is the way to play it now (the reporter, 2026-10-19). ProtonDB reports the Windows version running on Linux, so the Loading hang looks specific to Wine on macOS.

knownIssues.symptom: Stuck on Loading after starting or continuing a game
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed; Windows players report the same hang in the game's Steam discussions
knownIssues.fix: play the Mac version from Steam, which the developer fixed in October 2026
